items.statement: Test how dispersion changes conformational energetics and whether the resulting geometry change alters the electronic absorption of Z-cAACCy. Separate the direct energy contribution of the dispersion correction from geometric relaxation, and separate excitation energy, intensity and state identity.
items.expected: The conclusion follows the complete same-object control matrix, evaluated hypotheses and demonstrated sensitivity. Accept support, refutation or bounded ambiguity when justified by real results; do not force the author claim. A missing expanded calculation is a missing endpoint, not computed ambiguity. Numerical publication anchors apply only to like-defined source baselines and never substitute for new reference calculations. Avoid these scientific errors: Dropping the Dipp ligand, mixing energy/free-energy definitions, transferring thermal corrections to cross points, claiming post-SCF D3 changes fixed-geometry density, or equating red shift with larger oscillator strength.
